Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Vânzări cu amănuntul
Digital. Inspiring. Unique. 
 Tchibo is one of the ten largest eCommerce companies in Germany. We could never have attained this standing without the courage to constantly rethink the old ways. In the digital world
 at Tchibo, we work with the latest technologies to develop sustainable and eﬀective solutions. 
 Do you want to help us do this? Enrich our team with your fresh ideas! 
 Environment: 
 Product team with responsibility for the operation and further development of cloud infrastructure of the Online Webshop of Tchibo
 Technologies: 
 Google Cloud PlaIorm (GKE, IAM, VPC, Load Balancing, DNS, Secret Manager), Terraform,
 GitLab CI/CD, Kubernetes, Helm, GitOps (Flux), Flagger, IsAoObservability (Datadog or GCP Monitoring)
 Languages:
 English, German is a plus
 General Tasks: 
 • Infrastructure as Code: You will use Terraform to define and provision the underlying
 cloud infra that powers the Kubernetes clusters, PostgreSQL databases and storage our
 Online Shop lives on
 • Kubernetes: You orchestrate and evolve our production environments using Helm and
 GitOps workflows to keep the online business running smoothly
 • Observability Engineering: You build a best-in-class monitoring stack using Datadog to
 turn system data into actionable insights
 • Agentic SRE: You pour your knowledge into the inhouse build SRE agent to provide
 tailored and on-the-spot support to product teams or resolve issues on the fly
 • Automation First: You replace “everything manual” with clever code building the tooling
 that makes you deployments repeatable and self-healing
 Experience and needed skills 
 • Cloud native: Proven experience with Kubernetes – you understand how pods, ingresses
 and services interact.
 • Hyperscaler: Deep knowledge of GCP (or AWS) services and their pros and cons in action
 •Provisioning: Expert-level knowledge of Terraform – you know how to manage states,
 write modular code and automate changes on infra level
 • Persistence: You have seen PostgreSQL in productive environments, especially High
 Availability (HA) or backup/recovery strategies
 • Scripting: You have seen and used Shell, Bash or Golang
 • Up for the long run: You are ready to support the teams On-Call-Rotation (weekly)
 Nice-to-have 
 • Experience with GitOps tools (Flux, Flagger)
 • Knowledge of Helm/Kustomize, Istio (service mesh)
 • Experience with SRE practices (SLOs, SLIs, Error Budgets)
 • Basic knowledge of FinOps or cost optimization
 • Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks (e.g., CIS Benchmarks, PolicyController)
 Your Benefits: Together We Stay Diﬀerent 
 • Work-Life Balance : Flexible hybrid working policy, 26 vacation days + your birthday oﬀ.
 • Perks : Monthly transport allowance, meal tickets, health & life insurance.
 • Coﬀee Lovers Welcome : Free Tchibo coﬀee for home and oﬃce.
 • Innovative Work Culture : You’ll work on impactful projects in a collaborative and open-
 minded team.
 • Diversity & Inclusion : A place where your perspectives and ideas are valued.
